bibl.title: Nomination of Four Village Elders of Psinteo (P.Mich. inv. 214; 167 CE)
bibl.seg: Valentina Iannace, Nomination of Four Village Elders of Psinteo (P.Mich. inv. 214; 167 CE).
bibl.note: Edition of P.Mich. inv. 214, a nomination for four substitute presbyteroi of the village of Psinteo (Arsinoite nome). As it is addressed to the strategos from the komogrammateus of Apollonopolis and Psinteo, it represents the earliest evidence of the joint komogrammateia of those villages. Moreover, it records some proper names unattested elsewhere in the papyrological documentation. Psinteo (Arsinoite nome), 25 Feb. - 26 Mar. 167 CE.
